name: the reloaded page never presses the button
why: THE feature. The note is painted before the press, so a test that only looked for the note would pass with the click gone; the spec pins all 300 rows arriving with no click from the test.
grep: a recorded button is pressed again

name: the flag's URL is not checked
why: A flag left behind by another URL in the same tab must not start a fetch nobody asked for on this one.
grep: a flag recorded on another URL

name: the guard records no button
why: Without the recorded button the reloaded page can only fall back to the dialog — the behaviour this change replaces.

name: the reload guard is back below the definition merge
why: Where it used to stand: after the merge, the removal of the other sections from the visible page and (artist-releasegroups) a whole network pre-fetch pass, all thrown away by the reload. The spec sees it as the merge's '… configured' debug lines printing on the second press.
